Low range breaks at 88.2 and 96 kHz sample rates
note: Frame size from sample rate (4096 at 44.1/48k, 8192 at 88.2/96k); sweep tested at 4 rates. Uses 2x longest lag, not 4x, so 48k latency is unchanged

title: One octave-error frame goes straight through the median filter
note: Smoother holds jumps until they last 2/3/4 frames; octave-error tests

title: Even-length median is biased sharp
No interpolation when the dip lands on the longest lag
note: One extra lag computed so the last lag interpolates; still-falling dip returns null

title: Note name flickers at the quarter-tone boundary
note: NoteLatch: keeps note until >58 cents for 3 readings (wide jumps switch at once)

title: In-tune state chatters at the tolerance edge
note: InTuneLatch in intonation.ts with enter/exit thresholds and 150 ms grace for hold timer

title: Smoothing strength depends on screen refresh rate
note: Smoothing timed in ms (span median, ramp-invariant glide); tendencies capped at 30 readings/s; 60 vs 120 Hz test

title: Mic stays open when the tab is hidden, but analysis stops
note: Tuner stops on hidden tab, auto-resumes if mic permission granted, else shows tap to resume; e2e check

title: A microphone that disconnects is never detected
AudioContext suspension mid-session is not handled
No input device choice
note: Input select in tuner options, deviceId saved, falls back to default. No e2e: the e2e fake mic replaces getUserMedia

title: Stereo interfaces are downmixed
note: Mix/Left/Right input channel via ChannelSplitter, stereo requested when needed; routing unit tests. partial: no OfflineAudioContext in node tests and no stereo hardware check

title: Mic processing flags are requested but never checked
note: Reads track getSettings(); warns in options and under the tuner if processing stayed on

title: Bluetooth headset mics degrade silently
note: Bluetooth warning by label or sampleRate <= 16000. partial: needs checking on real Bluetooth headsets per platform

title: Sensitivity uses fixed RMS values with no noise-floor calibration
note: Calibrate to this room button: 2 s of noise, threshold max(0.001, 3x noise RMS). partial: optional continuous adaptation not done

title: Level meter cannot explain why nothing is detected
note: dB meter with threshold tick, clip light with 1 s hold, No signal / Too quiet / Too low status

title: No filtering before detection
note: High-pass at 0.7x lowest pitch (lowest string in strings mode) and 5 kHz low-pass before analyser; e2e 14 cent check still passes

title: DC offset keeps full detection running
note: Level gate uses mean-removed RMS; DC-offset test counts lag-search runs

title: Worst-case YIN cost lands on noisy rooms
note: FFT difference function (in-house FFT), matches direct sum; timing test ~0.5 ms vs ~6.8 ms per frame. Timing is a vitest test, not vitest bench

title: One frame length for every pitch
note: detectPitchAdaptive re-runs on newest max(1024, 4 periods) samples above 300 Hz; A5 to B5 step test

title: Top of the range is untested
note: Sweep extended to C8 at 44.1 and 48 kHz; worst 0.70 cent, so no spectral refinement needed

title: Metronome gate ignores frame length and output latency
note: nearClick takes output latency and frame length; tracker passes both

title: Gating stays on when the click is inaudible
note: ClickAudibility checks 4 clicks for a 3 dB rise; gating turns off with a notice

title: The tuner reads the app's own reference tones
note: Reference playing badge; clean readings within 3 cents of a string reference or hear target are dropped. partial: no loopback e2e

title: Follow drone can sustain itself forever
note: FollowState releases the follow drone 0.6 s after the last voiced note

title: Follow drone and string references can be inaudible on phones
note: Reference octave setting (same, up 1, up 2, auto 110 Hz) for follow drone, string references and hear target

title: Strings mode needle is noisier than chromatic mode
note: Tracker publishes smoothed displayFrequency; strings mode measures from it

title: Far-detuned strings are assigned to the wrong string and give the wrong direction
note: StringFollower keeps the active string until 300 ms near another; Tune up/down hint beyond 50 cents

title: Manually selected string gives nonsense for other strings
note: Sounds like the X string chip with tap to switch when a manual string is far off

title: Pluck and strike transients pollute readings
note: OnsetGate skips 120 ms after a 6 dB rise for hold timer and session stats in strings mode

title: Reference tone cannot be configured
note: Reference sound, length (short, hold, repeat) and volume options; Hear target toggles with aria-pressed

title: No custom string tunings, capo or per-string offsets
note: Custom tunings editor with per-string notes, cent offsets and capo; stored and sanitized in settings

title: Common instruments and tunings are missing
note: Added 19 instruments (7 and 8 string guitar, 12-string, 6-string bass, ukulele variants, tenor and Irish banjo, mandola, octave mandolin, bouzoukis, oud, erhu, viols, solo bass, 34-string lever harp) with maker or reference URLs; sitar left out as unverified

title: Pure fifths offered for mandolin
note: Pure fifths removed for mandolin since frets are equal tempered

title: String buttons wrap into two rows on phones
note: Strings sit in one grid row sized by count, scrolling sideways above 8; e2e checks one row at 320 px

title: String buttons show state by colour only and have no labels
note: Check or arrow glyph per string, aria-label with note and cents, aria-pressed for manual pick. partial: no axe-core check

title: The whole display is one button that hides the readout
note: Separate Start or Stop button with aria-pressed; readout no longer inside a button. partial: not checked with NVDA or VoiceOver

title: Trace and tendencies have no text alternative
note: Hidden text summary of the trace updated each second; tendencies tap for detail and have a hidden table

title: No non-speech audio feedback for players who cannot see the screen
note: Sound cues option: rising or falling chirps, faster when further off, silent in tune, gated from the tracker

title: No forced-colors (high contrast) support
note: forced-colors styles for ring, bar, meter, strings, switches and heat map; e2e emulates forced colors. partial: not checked in real Windows High Contrast

title: Strobe ignores reduced motion
note: With prefers-reduced-motion the strobe bands stand still, shifted by the cents error, with a short note; e2e emulates it

title: The strobe is not a real strobe
note: Phase strobe: SampleClock aligns analyser buffers, Hann weighted quadrature demodulation, atan2 phase; unit test of 0.3 cent rate, e2e shows still bands in tune

title: Strobe partial rows are made up
note: Rows demodulate at 2f and 4f, fade when that partial is weak, and are labelled; unit test with a 3 cent sharp second partial

title: Every display is fixed at ±50 cents
note: Scale setting 50, 20, 10 or auto (zooms to 10 after 500 ms within 10 cents); pure mapping functions used by ring, bar and trace

title: Ring cents ticks have no numbers
note: Ring labels at half and full scale, signed

title: Bar scale labels are wrong
note: Bar labels every 20 cents at 50, every half scale when zoomed, signed

title: Readout precision too coarse for fine work
note: Decimal cents option (auto at tolerance 2 or less), signed number kept next to in tune, two decimals of Hz below 100 Hz

title: Tolerance choices are limited
note: Custom tolerance input from 0.5 to 25 cents, clamped in settings

title: In-tune lock is fixed and silent on iPhone
note: Lock after 0.5 to 5 s and an optional chime gated from the tracker. partial: chime not tried on an iPhone

title: The reading disappears as soon as the note ends
note: Keep last note on screen: greyed with N s ago until the next note; e2e checks it

title: No steadiness feedback per long tone
note: LongToneWatcher reports length, spread and drift when a held note of 2 s or more ends; shown under the readout.

title: Trace cannot show which note was played
note: Trace breaks and labels each note, tap pauses, drag scrolls back through 60 s. traceRuns and clampTraceOffset tested.

title: Tendencies mix incompatible data
note: Tendencies kept per tuning key (A4, temperament, tonic) in their own store.

title: Tendencies include slides and attacks, weighted by frame rate
note: Stored by concert pitch class and transposed only for display.

title: Tendencies never age
note: Per-day buckets (60 days) plus all time; Last 7 days / All time / Older switch.

title: Tendencies grid overflows on narrow phones and hides large values
note: Container query switches to 6 columns when narrow; clamped bars get arrow caps.

title: Saving tendencies re-renders the whole tuner every 5 seconds
note: Readings weighted by seconds and only counted after 300 ms steady (StableNoteGate).

title: New DOM nodes every frame
note: Readout nodes built once; setText only writes changed text.

title: Expensive canvas drawing every frame
note: Theme colours cached, one path per colour, trace drawn at most 30 fps.

title: Hidden ring still updates, and every write happens even when nothing changed
note: Ring only updated when shown; ring writes cached so unchanged frames write nothing.

title: Glow filter repaints on every frame
note: Blur filter replaced by a radial gradient halo that moves with the tip.; partial: paint time not measured on a phone

title: Bar needle animates `left`
note: Bar needle moves by transform in px; no transition with Responsive steadiness.

title: Ring rotation lags in fast passages
note: Ring snaps without animation on fast note changes; Keep C at the top option.

title: Stopping leaves a stale reading
note: Stopping clears note, cents, ring and needle. e2e checks the display clears.

title: A second tap during the permission prompt starts instead of cancelling
note: Starting state with aria-busy; a second tap cancels a pending start.

title: Microphone errors give no recovery steps
note: micFailure maps error names to plain messages; denied shows How to allow the microphone.; partial: only desktop Chrome steps are sourced (support.google.com/chrome/answer/2693767); other browsers get general steps

title: No auto-start even when permission is already granted
note: Start when opened option, and resumes when returning to a tuner that was listening, if mic already allowed.

title: No stop after silence, and practice time counts silence
note: Practice time counts voiced seconds only; stops after N silent minutes (default 5, 0 never).

title: Keyboard shortcuts are thin and Space gets swallowed
note: Space, Enter, R/B/S, [ ], arrow keys; listed in the shortcuts sheet.

title: A4 range and presets exclude historical and regional pitches
note: Range 350 to 500; Baroque 392/415/466, Classical 430/435, Modern chips cited to gamutmusic.com.; partial: no chips for 432 or Highland pipe pitch (no authoritative source found); they can still be typed

title: A4 cannot be typed and steps are coarse
note: A4 is a number input with 0.1 steps and shows cents from 440.

title: Non-equal temperaments move A away from the chosen reference
note: Default anchor keeps A4 at the reference; option to anchor the key note. Tested for every temperament and tonic.

title: Well temperaments labelled with a misleading "Key"
note: Well temperaments label the picker Starts on and reset it to C.

title: Tonic picker does not say whether it is concert or written
note: Key picker shown in written pitch for transposing instruments, stored as concert, with the concert note shown.

title: Just intonation ratios are fixed
note: Per-degree just ratio choices (Huygens-Fokker list) and a Harmonic 7th preset; tested against ratioToCents.

title: Meantone wolf position and enharmonics are fixed
note: Notes in tune option moves the meantone chain; A flat pure with the A flat to C sharp chain (tested).

title: Temperament targets are invisible
note: Ring shows each note offset from equal; readout shows vs equal cents.

title: No quick tuning presets
note: Saved tuning presets (A4, temperament, key, instrument key) as chips with delete.

title: Tonic does not follow the drone
note: Key follows the drone option uses the lowest drone and retunes drones. Note: combining it with Drone follows you moves the key with the follow drone.

title: No harmonic-partial mode for brass
note: Partials mode: pick a fundamental, shows partial number and its cents vs equal. Unit and e2e tested.

title: No Scala import or wider historical temperament library
note: Scala .scl import as a 12-note temperament (parser tested against the format spec), plus Kirnberger III, 1/6-comma meantone, Kellner and Neidhardt I from the Scala archive; partial: scales other than 12 notes per octave import only as a message

title: No tuning systems with other than 12 notes
note: Notes per octave setting (12, 19, 24, 31) for the chromatic tuner with chain-of-fifths names and a ring with that many notes; partial: 53 and other divisions not offered

title: No maqam or makam accidentals
note: Quarter-tone sharp and flat signs (Unicode U+1D132, U+1D133) name the in-between steps of 24 and 31 equal; partial: maqam and makam scale presets need verified sources or musicians

title: Tonic cannot be set as a frequency for Indian music
note: Sa mode: Sa set in Hz (or from the last note), targets are the 22 shrutis from Thakur (Resonance 2015); partial: no single verified 12-svara komal and tivra ratio set, so those show as shruti labels

title: Cannot tune to an existing instrument's own scale
note: My scale mode tunes to notes captured from an instrument (median over 1.5 s), in any octave, managed in Tools

title: Transposition list has wrong octaves and gaps
note: Transpositions now keep the octave (tenor sax +14, baritone +21, piccolo -12, and more) with cited sources; unknown stored ids fall back to concert

title: Written and concert pitch cannot be shown together
note: A 'concert B♭3' line shows next to the written note for transposing instruments (e2e check)

title: Spelling ignores the key
note: Accidentals setting sharps, flats or by key (flat major keys F to G♭), using the written key note

title: German and solfège naming are incomplete
note: German Cis/Des/Es/As/B/H, Italian Do Re Mi, chromatic movable do from the key, and Helmholtz octave names

title: No note lock or arbitrary target
note: Tap a ring note to lock the tuner to it (hold to hear it), or type a frequency; far readings show '-3 st +12¢'; Auto chip unlocks

title: No timpani mode
note: Timpani mode reads the pitch of each strike from a long FFT and holds it until the next strike; partial: not validated on recorded timpani

title: No bell or handbell partial analysis
note: Bells mode lists the 5 strongest peaks; pick the nominal and the others are named hum, prime, tierce, quint (Hibbert); partial: not validated on real bells

title: No piano stretch tuning
note: Tools: piano stretch fits inharmonicity B from struck notes (Fletcher 1964) and can apply a stretch curve to the tuner; partial: not validated on a real piano

title: No beat-rate meter
note: Tools: beat meter counts slow beats (up to about 6 per second) between two close tones

title: No aural temperament-setting aid
note: Tuning sheet shows beat rates of fifths and major thirds F3 to F4 for non-equal temperaments

title: No instrument tendency reference or guided tuning
note: Tools: known tendencies for trumpet, clarinet and sax (cited) with a guided check, plus a tip under the reading; partial: flute and other instruments unsourced, exact trumpet octaves inferred from 'low'

title: No guitar intonation (saddle) check
note: Tools: guitar intonation compares the 12th fret note with the 12th fret harmonic and says which way to move the saddle (Fender)

title: No explicit measure button
note: Tools: Measure 3 s gives mean Hz and cents with spread; checked in e2e

title: No pitch-matching practice for singers
No vocal range finder
note: Tools: vocal range finder saves lowest and highest steady notes; partial: using the range in matching exercises belongs to 03-95

title: No choir pitch-drift check
note: Tools: choir drift takes the key note at the start and end and reports how far the pitch moved

title: No ensemble tuning log for teachers
note: Tools: tuning checks log with names, sort and CSV export

title: No dual tuner
note: Tools: dual tuner reads left and right input channels side by side; partial: not tested with stereo hardware

title: No haptic direction cues
note: Option: vibration cues, two short pulses when sharp, one long pulse when flat, none when in tune; partial: vibration not testable on this machine

title: Strings mode detection range is not narrowed to the instrument
note: Strings mode limits the search to 0.7x lowest to 1.5x highest string, so a bass low E with strong harmonics reads correctly

title: "Hear target" can play a target from the previous tuning
note: Hear target stores what the target is (note, string, partial) and recomputes its frequency from the current tuning when pressed

title: Recorder report and live tuner disagree by design
note: Recorder analysis now runs the same processFrame path (smoothing, hold, sensitivity) as the live tuner

title: Idle frame skipping delays note starts
note: Removed idle every-other-frame skipping; the first loud frame is analysed (unit test)

title: Tracker logic is untested and response time is unmeasured
note: processFrame is unit tested (hold, gating, onset, frame-rate independence); e2e measures step settle within 2 cents (about 100 ms headless)

title: No wide-screen layout
note: Two-column tuner layout at 900 px and wider, with e2e check at 1280 px

title: Tempo changes can lag up to two beats at slow tempos
note: New MetronomeSequence builds each beat only when it enters the lookahead, so tempo applies from the next beat. Unit tested 20 to 200 BPM.

title: Changing subdivision mid-beat schedules a stray, out-of-order click
note: Subdivision is read per beat when the beat is built; no stray or out-of-order clicks. Unit tested.

title: Meter changes apply mid-bar with odd beat numbers
note: Meter, accents and grouping are locked per bar and change at the barline. Unit tested.

title: The polyrhythm layer is scheduled a whole bar ahead
note: Poly is a continuous cycle built per beat with exact integer math, so it follows tempo and turns off at once. Unit tested.

title: Stop does not silence clicks that are already scheduled
note: Each run plays through its own gain node that fades over 5 ms and disconnects on stop.

title: No guard when the timer runs late: clicks in the past play in a burst
note: Late events more than 20 ms past move the run forward instead of bursting. Unit tested with a fake clock.

title: Background tab timer throttling can break the click
note: partial: ticks come from an inline Worker with a 1 s lookahead while hidden; the 10 minute hidden-tab log test was not run.

title: Beat visuals pile up and flash in a burst when the tab returns
note: Visual events are queued and any more than 50 ms stale are dropped. Unit tested.

title: Visuals use setTimeout and forced reflows instead of a frame loop on the audio clock
note: partial: one rAF loop mapped with getOutputTimestamp, animations restarted via getAnimations instead of reflows; frame-to-click offset not measured.

title: A suspended or interrupted AudioContext is not detected
note: partial: statechange sets a stalled state, a banner offers resume from the next barline; no e2e ctx.suspend check (context is not exposed to the page).
